properties.name: app.jwt.secret
properties.description: HMAC-SHA512 secret for JWT signing (min 64 bytes)

properties.name: app.jwt.expiration-ms
properties.description: JWT expiration in milliseconds

properties.name: app.cookie.secure
properties.description: Emit cookies with the Secure flag (HTTPS-only). Set to false only for local HTTP dev.

properties.name: app.minio.endpoint
properties.description: MinIO server endpoint URL

properties.name: app.minio.access-key
properties.description: MinIO access key

properties.name: app.minio.secret-key
properties.description: MinIO secret key

properties.name: app.minio.bucket
properties.description: MinIO bucket name

properties.name: app.meilisearch.host
properties.description: Meilisearch server URL

properties.name: app.meilisearch.api-key
properties.description: Meilisearch API key

properties.name: app.email.hash-salt
properties.description: Salt for SHA-256 email hashing

properties.name: app.email.from
properties.description: From address for transactional emails (must match the domain authenticated at the SMTP provider for deliverability)

properties.name: app.email.keepalive.to
properties.description: Recipient of the automatic SMTP keep-alive email. Blank disables the feature.

properties.name: app.email.keepalive.threshold-days
properties.description: Days of SMTP inactivity before a keep-alive email is sent

properties.name: app.email.keepalive.cron
properties.description: Cron expression for the daily SMTP keep-alive check

properties.name: app.kofi.verification-token
properties.description: Ko-fi webhook verification token

properties.name: app.discord.bot-token
properties.description: Discord bot token (verified-role bot). Blank disables the feature.

properties.name: app.discord.guild-id
properties.description: Discord guild (server) ID where the verified role is assigned

properties.name: app.discord.verified-role-id
properties.description: Discord role ID granted to verified members

properties.name: app.discord.supporter-role-id
properties.description: Discord role ID granted to Ko-fi supporters (donation >= 5 EUR). Blank disables.

properties.name: app.discord.announce-channel-id
properties.description: Discord channel ID for the hourly new-documents digest. Blank disables announcements.

properties.name: app.analytics.retention-days
properties.description: Days of daily_stats rows kept by the nightly prune (anonymous usage counters)

properties.name: app.frontend.url
properties.description: Frontend base URL for OAuth redirects

properties.name: freenote.cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Comma-separated CORS allowed origins
